en:
Illness brought on by age and
overwork forced Motonari to
rest for a time.



Seizing on this lull,
Shikanosuke met Sanehisa's
orphaned son, Magoshiro,
and won his consent to lead the
restoration army as Amago head.

Hashiba Hideyoshi, learning of
this, approached Shikanosuke and
offered to mediate with Nobunaga.

note: Hideyoshi orders an attendant to bring in Katsuhisa and Shikanosuke (U05148); 'them' restored.
